title: ApexChat
description:
ApexChat is a modern chat management plugin for Minecraft 1.21.x that adds private messages, chat clearing, and staff moderation tools.
Lightweight, fast, and fully compatible with LuckPerms (optional).
body:
ApexChat is a lightweight chat management plugin for Minecraft 1.21.x. It adds private messages, chat clearing, mute tools, and optional LuckPerms prefix support.

Features:

Private Messages (/pmsg, /msg, /pm, /w, /reply)

Clear your own chat (/clearchat)

Clear global chat (/clearchat all)

Mute and unmute players (/mute, /unmute)

Toggle global chat mute (/mutechat)

Optional LuckPerms prefix hook (no hard dependency)

Commands:

/clearchat – Clears your own chat

/clearchat all – Clears chat for everyone

/pmsg <player> <message> – Sends a private message

/reply <message> – Replies to the last PM

/mute <player> – Mutes a player

/unmute <player> – Unmutes a player

/mutechat – Toggles global chat mute

Permissions:

apexchat.clearchat.self (default: true)

apexchat.clearchat.all (default: op)

apexchat.msg (default: true)

apexchat.mute (default: op)

apexchat.mutechat (default: op)

apexchat.bypass.mute (default: op)

apexchat.bypass.globalmute (default: op)

Compatible with:

Minecraft 1.21.x

Spigot, Paper, Purpur

LuckPerms (optional)

Install: Drop the jar into /plugins and restart your server.

Author: Ralph Turner (pixelesdev)
